snippet.title: Legends of Castile - Game - Point and click adventure - Demo trailer
snippet.description:
Legends of Castile is a point and click adventure game based on an original fantasy/comedy story placed in Spain in Castile region set in 19th century, where a series of folk legends about mythological creatures take place. In the game, you will be able to advance in the story by solving integrated riddles/puzzles, meeting all kind of characters, defeating mythological folk creatures with your wit and exploring places all around Castile.

Add to Steam wish list and play demo when is available (the demo will come out in the middle of July):
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2325200/Legends_of_Castile

Official website:
https://www.LegendsOfCastile.com

Twitter:
https://twitter.com/legendscastile

Instagram:
https://www.instagram.com/legendsofcastile_game/

Original Music: Grzegorz Drozdowski (https://www.youtube.com/@grzegorzdrozdowskimusic)

Sound design by Maxim Grachev (https://sound-max.com/)

Voiced by Duffy Weber (https://twitter.com/DuffyPWeber)

Features
- An original story with mythological creatures, witches, humor and puzzles.
- Female main character.
- Classic frame by frame 12 fps animation.
- Full HD graphics.
- Not too explicit references to the adventure game classics.
- Inspired in adventures like Monkey Island, Broken Sword and Day of the Tentacle.
- More than 30 characters and creatures to interact with.
- More than 30 hand drawn environments, drawn on paper and colored digitally.
- Texts in English and Spanish languages.
- No panel/mechanical exogenous adventure puzzles (guaranteed!).
- Context sensitive three verb coin interface.
- Resolve puzzles in parallel while you discover legends of the oral tradition from Castile (Spain).
